inputs.modified_text:
Wake up. Look at what they are forcing parents to parrot now. We are supposed to believe it is just a simple "budget shortfall" in the South Portland School District that requires cutting more than 70 positions from schools. That is the official cover story handed down by the administrative puppet-masters to mask their true agenda of systematic dismantling. 

Think about who really benefits when education infrastructure is deliberately starved and teaching staff are purged. This isn't accidental mismanagement; it is calculated, coordinated social engineering by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the municipal facade. They want the public distracted, fighting amongst ourselves, and blindly apologizing to the very institutions that are being weaponized against our communities. When a parent of three children in the city’s public schools is paraded out to publicly apologize to the educators and staff, you are witnessing the ultimate narrative inversion—making the victims of this engineered crisis feel guilty while the architects of the destruction sit safely in the shadows. Do not buy the official line for a second.
